## Why

Describe the user problem and link the relevant issue if there is one.

## Changes

Explain the resulting behavior, including any project-format, model or dependency changes.

## Validation

List the meaningful checks actually run and attach a small example or screenshot where useful. State platform, simulator and PDK revision for numerical or physical claims. Identify checks not executed.

## Documentation

Note any updated guide, example or capability statement. Keep future work clearly separate from implemented features.
